questions.question: Which store should hold the per-user quotas, given that the server runs on one machine and restarts are rare?

options.label: SQLite (Recommended)
options.description: One file next to the server, no extra process, easy to back up.

options.label: Postgres
options.description: A shared server, more to run, useful once several machines share the quotas.

options.label: Plain JSON file
options.description: The least to build; slow once the file grows past a few thousand users.
